"""
Tests for Content-Length header behavior on bodyless requests.
These tests will FAIL against current codebase - that's the point.

import unittest
import requests
from requests import Request, Session


class TestContentLengthHeader(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify Content-Length is NOT sent for bodyless GET/HEAD requests."""

    def test_get_request_no_body_omits_content_length(self):
        """GET without body should NOT include Content-Length header."""
        req = Request('GET', 'http://httpbin.org/get')
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        # This WILL FAIL - current behavior sends Content-Length: 0
        self.assertNotIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers,
            "GET request without body should not have Content-Length header")

    def test_head_request_no_body_omits_content_length(self):
        """HEAD without body should NOT include Content-Length header."""
        req = Request('HEAD', 'http://httpbin.org/get')
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        self.assertNotIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers,
            "HEAD request without body should not have Content-Length header")

    def test_get_with_empty_data_omits_content_length(self):
        """GET with data=None should NOT include Content-Length."""
        req = Request('GET', 'http://httpbin.org/get', data=None)
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        self.assertNotIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers,
            "GET with data=None should not have Content-Length header")

    def test_post_without_body_includes_content_length_zero(self):
        """POST without body SHOULD include Content-Length: 0."""
        req = Request('POST', 'http://httpbin.org/post')
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        # POST should always have Content-Length per spec
        self.assertIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers,
            "POST request should have Content-Length header")
        self.assertEqual(prepared.headers['Content-Length'], '0')

    def test_put_without_body_includes_content_length_zero(self):
        """PUT without body SHOULD include Content-Length: 0."""
        req = Request('PUT', 'http://httpbin.org/put')
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        self.assertIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers,
            "PUT request should have Content-Length header")
        self.assertEqual(prepared.headers['Content-Length'], '0')

    def test_get_with_body_includes_content_length(self):
        """GET with actual body SHOULD include correct Content-Length."""
        req = Request('GET', 'http://httpbin.org/get', data='test body')
        prepared = req.prepare()
        
        # If there IS a body, Content-Length is required
        self.assertIn('Content-Length', prepared.headers)
        self.assertEqual(prepared.headers['Content-Length'], '9')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
